Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gamerule

Interface GameRuleService

public interface GameRuleService
Typed game-rule resolution and serialized persistence operations. Effective values follow defaults, then custom globals, then source-arena overrides. Mutation futures perform persistence asynchronously; successful change events are fired synchronously on the Bukkit main thread.
